info.name: HustleHub+ API - Part 2 full flow
info.description:
Full API flow for authentication, gigs, bookings, transactions, income, security headers and rate limiting.

Run from HustleHub/api with `npm test` after configuring .env and starting the API. The Newman collection creates fresh @hustlehub.test accounts. Run the rate-limit folder last; it intentionally exhausts the API limit for the source IP for up to 15 minutes.

Clean test data with `npm run test:models -- --cleanup` (or `node test-models.js --cleanup`). For HTTPS, update the baseUrl variable to https://localhost:4000 and bypass verification only for the locally self-signed certificate.

item.name: Create gig with an oversized body (over 10kb)

exec: pm.test('Error says the body is too large', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.match(/too large/i));

request.description: JSON bodies are capped at 10kb, so a huge request is refused before it reaches the controller.
A body that is not valid JSON is rejected cleanly instead of crashing the request.

item.name: 4. Rate limiting (run last)
item.description: Run these with the Collection Runner: each looping request repeats itself until its limit is hit. Afterwards your computer is blocked from the whole API for 15 minutes, so restart the server (Ctrl+C, npm start) before running the collection again.
